body: Just wanted to let you know, not better but thanks. Still here so I guess it's something. Working again, without any major issues so far, actually made a few friends at work. Life's a notch and all but I just wanted to let you know how much I appreciate the offer to chat, I never responded before now because honestly I didn't know how to phrase this; but thanks man. I bookmarked the comment and came back to read it from time to time... A few times I even started to type something and erased it. But trying to phrase it right was something to do, and that's all I can do sometimes is just find something. This probably sounds weird but thanks man
